translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer.

The completion draft intentionally preserves coherent traditional English syntax where a verse has not yet received a curated Hebrew-sensitive rendering; it does not mix archaic and modern grammar. Major identified lexical/textual issues receive explicit overrides and notes.
safety_note: Feeling forgotten by God is allowed inside scripture and should never be treated as spiritual failure or grounds for self-harm.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Scrolls where extant, and other relevant witnesses during the global audit.
Preserve Psalm numbering and superscription differences across Hebrew and Greek traditions rather than silently harmonizing them.
